age.evidence: For all experiments, adult transgenic mice and WT littermates of both sexes were used.

sex.evidence: For all experiments, adult transgenic mice and WT littermates of both sexes were used.

dosing.doses_raw: 0.1 µM to 10 µM (applied to isolated atrial preparations in organ bath)
dosing.evidence: We first cumulatively applied LSD (0.1 µM to 10 µM).

handling.evidence: Animals were maintained and handled according to approved protocols of the animal welfare committees of the University of Halle-Wittenberg, Germany.

judge_notes: No behavioural assays scored: this study uses isolated atrial preparations, Langendorff-perfused hearts, Western blot, and radioligand binding — all ex vivo / in vitro work on cardiac tissue. No in vivo behavioural assays of rodents were performed. All three candidates correctly returned an empty assays list.
LSD was applied to isolated tissue at µM concentrations rather than dosed systemically to animals; no mg/kg dose is applicable. Route coded as 'other' (organ bath application).
